name: @optn/docker-dev
description: OPTN Wallet contributor Docker lab (tests/tooling — not production wallet)

scripts.shell: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml exec dev bash
scripts.test:core: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml run --rm --no-deps --workdir /optn dev bash -lc "npm ci && npm run test:core"
scripts.logs:tor: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml --profile fusion-lab logs -f tor
